items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I took a drummer, only had a drummer and had to use Italian musicians.

ctx.x: That was a show made up from -- well, it was -- Jazz Train was the history, supposed to be a history of American jazz with theater, and we did things like Porgy and Bess and -- and it was a nice show. We had Leslie Scott. He was the star. And Ura Lee Unitas -- I forgot her -- she was, you know, a singer, a great fine (inaudible) singer. And we had Cooken Brown and had a chorus line. And we had about 40 people.
And we went to -- went from here to Rome. We opened in Rome for a week, and we didn't take -- I took a drummer, only had a drummer and had to use Italian musicians.
